# Adam AI — Personal Operating System & Autonomous Intelligence

> Adam AI is a next-generation Personal Operating System combining a conversational core, autonomous agents, multi-tool execution, persistent memory, and rigorous verification.

## Core Capabilities
- **Autonomous Agent Swarm**: Self-directed reasoning, task planning, and background execution.
- **Persistent Memory & Context**: Long-term semantic recall and user preference synchronization.
- **Multi-Tool Execution**: Web search, media generation, code evaluation, and structured data handling.
- **Human-in-the-Loop Verification**: Deterministic checks and safety boundaries.

## Endpoints & API Reference
- `POST /api/chat`: Primary conversational streaming endpoint.
- `POST /api/agent`: Autonomous agent execution endpoint.
- `GET /api/health`: System health and status check.
